site_title: The Parables of Jesus — An NFL Player Study Series | PAO
site_description: An 11-week study series for NFL players from Pro Athletes Outreach, walking through the parables of Jesus.
hero_intro: Jesus was a masterful storyteller. He used parables — short stories drawn from everyday life — to reveal something about Himself and the upside-down, surprising nature of His Kingdom. Simple on the surface, rich with deeper meaning for those willing to listen with open hearts.
